404	export function mergeAboutTheatreValue(
405	  value?: Partial<AboutTheatreValue> | null,
406	): AboutSceneState {
407	  const defaults = ABOUT_DEFAULT_SCENE_STATE;
408	  return mergeAboutSceneState({
409	    camera: value?.camera,
410	    light: value?.light
411	      ? {
412	          ...defaults.light,
413	          ...value.light,
414	          rig: value.light.rig
415	            ? mergeAboutTransformState(value.light.rig, defaults.light.rig)
416	            : defaults.light.rig,
417	        }
418	      : undefined,
419	    earth: value?.earth,
420	    rocket: value?.rocket,
421	    jetEngine: value?.jetEngine,
422	    astronaut: value?.astronaut,
423	    terrian: value?.terrian,
424	  });

451	function blendAboutTransformState(
452	  from: AboutSceneState["earth"],
453	  to: AboutSceneState["earth"],
454	  alpha: number,
455	): AboutSceneState["earth"] {
456	  return {
457	    position: blendAboutVec3State(from.position, to.position, alpha),
458	    rotation: blendAboutVec3State(from.rotation, to.rotation, alpha),
459	    scale: blendAboutVec3State(from.scale, to.scale, alpha),
460	    visible: alpha < 0.5 ? from.visible : to.visible,
461	  };
462	}
463	
464	function blendAboutVec3State(
465	  from: AboutSceneState["camera"]["position"],
466	  to: AboutSceneState["camera"]["position"],
467	  alpha: number,
468	): AboutSceneState["camera"]["position"] {
469	  return {
470	    x: blendAboutNumber(from.x, to.x, alpha),
471	    y: blendAboutNumber(from.y, to.y, alpha),
472	    z: blendAboutNumber(from.z, to.z, alpha),
473	  };
474	}
475	
476	function blendAboutNumber(from: number, to: number, alpha: number): number {
477	  const mix = clampBlendAlpha(alpha);
478	  return from + (to - from) * mix;
479	}
480	
481	function clampBlendAlpha(alpha: number): number {
482	  if (!Number.isFinite(alpha)) return 0;
483	  if (alpha <= 0) return 0;
484	  if (alpha >= 1) return 1;
485	  return alpha;
486	}
